evidence.quote: I believe the Federal Reserve is likely to continue supporting the economy for some time through accommodative monetary policy.
But I expect that these pricing pressures will be temporary, easing over the course of this year as supply bottlenecks are gradually resolved.
the potential for a wave of small business failures is one of the main risks to my expectation that our economy will make further substantial progress toward our goal of full employment.
My own expectation is for strong growth and a rebound in the labor force participation rate once the economy fully reopens.
At this point, the economy is still a long way from those goals. We are making progress, but I think it will take some time for us to get there.
if my outlook for inflation were to change materially, my assessment of the appropriate stance of monetary policy would change as well.

parsed.rationale: Bowman expects strong growth and transitory inflation but emphasizes downside risks from small business failures and signals accommodation will continue for some time. A caveat about inflation uncertainty tempers the dovish lean slightly.
